scope: current technical recoverability of decision-time observations across core history, debrief, host summaries, and the text-first browser boundary

source_contract.debrief_timing_rule: src/debrief/report.rs: Decision quality: review the observations recorded before each command
source_contract.debrief_revision_boundary: src/debrief/report.rs: Prior committed observations remain unchanged in history; revisions affect only the current briefing.
source_contract.host_replay_read: src/mcp/session.rs: pub fn get_replay(&self, request: GetReplayRequest)
source_contract.written_history_boundary: gui/README.md: history, replay metadata, and host-provided debrief distinct

recovery_contract.core_history: Each immutable Transition retains the observation paired with its command, actor decision, effects, next state, and state hash; this is the technical decision-time record.
recovery_contract.debrief: The existing debrief directs review to observations recorded before each command and preserves prior committed observations when a later reported estimate is revised.
recovery_contract.host_history_replay: Host history and replay reads retain immutable transition-summary alignment, command/event/effect text, transition counts, seed/latest-hash metadata, and hash continuity.
recovery_contract.browser_current: The current text-first browser history view renders turn, command, and state hash summaries and separately receives the current actor-visible observation; it does not replay full historical observations for every decision.
recovery_contract.written_fallback: Commands, history, hashes, source/status text, and debrief lines remain available as written text without audio or decorative motion.

presentation_surface.core_authority: Core history and host debrief functions own decision-time observation retention and recovery; presentation remains read-only.
presentation_surface.host_summary_boundary: Host summary reads are recoverable and hash-aligned but intentionally narrower than the core Transition record; they do not imply resolved-input or private-rationale disclosure.
presentation_surface.browser_boundary: The live GUI exposes shared campaign-coverage and currently recovers summary history, not a browser-native full decision-time observation timeline.

open_work: browser-native per-decision observation timeline and visual recovery review
causal attribution visualization linked to recovered decision-time context
counterfactual differences, distributional outcome views, export behavior, and instructor-surface design
human accessibility and educational usability review
limits: This record documents current technical recovery boundaries only; it does not establish a complete browser timeline or human decision-time comprehension.
Host summaries are narrower than core history and do not expose resolved inputs, hidden state, private rationale, calibrated forecasts, legal conclusions, or educational results.

No observation field, browser route, timeline control, persistence, screenshot, asset, audio file, true-state view, causal graph, counterfactual, distributional view, or export format is created or promoted.
No human visual quality, accessibility, classroom effectiveness, policy-validity, or public-release claim is made.
